+# Architecture
+
+**Goal:** Build a notes app: title, content, tag Work/Personal/Ideas, search by text, edit and delete
+
+**Preset:** fastapi-vanilla
+
+A SQLite table stores notes. A database module offers add, list, update, and delete functions. FastAPI routes under /api/notes call them. A single HTML page lists notes with tags, a form to add one, and Edit and Delete buttons on each.
+
+## Product spec
+
+### Notes app
+
+Keep personal and work notes with tags and search functionality.
+
+**notes**: title (string), content (string), tag (Work / Personal / Ideas). Operations: list, create, update, delete.
+
+Features:
+- Form to add a note with title, content, and tag
+- List of notes showing title, content, and tag
+- Search functionality to find notes by text
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every note
+
+## Endpoints
+- `POST /api/notes`: Create a new note
+- `GET /api/notes`: List all notes
+- `PUT /api/notes/{id}`: Update a note
+- `DELETE /api/notes/{id}`: Delete a note
+
+## Web page must
+- Form with title, content, and a tag select (Work, Personal, Ideas) and a Save button
+- List of notes showing title, content, and tag
+- Search functionality to find notes by text
+- Edit and Delete buttons on every note
+- Show error messages from the API
